title: Krull intersection theorem for an ideal in the Jacobson radical
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $I\subseteq R$ an ideal contained in the Jacobson radical of $R$ (the intersection of all maximal ideals of $R$), and $M$ a finitely generated $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Then $\bigcap_{n\ge0}I^nM=0$.
